gpg_home.description: Path to the GPG home directory (GPGCONF_DIR), where keyrings and configuration files are stored.

keyserver.description: Default keyserver URL used for key lookup and import/export operations. Must be an HKP, LDAP, or HTTPS URL.

keyserver_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network operations to the keyserver.

backup_enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic backups of the keyring before destructive operations.

backup_dir.description: Directory path where backup copies of the keyring are stored.

backup_retention_count.description: Maximum number of backup files to retain in the backup directory.

notify_enabled.description: Whether to enable desktop notifications for long-running or critical operations.

notify_sound.description: Optional path to a sound file to play with notifications (desktop-specific).
